# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: booleans, comparison, the conditional (spec 6.2).

== true literal
expr true
want Bool true

== false literal
expr false
want Bool false

== negation
expr !true
want Bool false

== word not
expr not false
want Bool true

== conjunction
expr true && false
want Bool false

== disjunction
expr false || true
want Bool true

# `x` is the pipeline register, reserved before any scope map answers, so the
# variable here is named level
== word operators
env level: Num = 5
expr level > 0 and not (level > 10) or level == 42
want Bool true

== conjunction short-circuits
expr false && (1 / 0 > 0)
want Bool false

== disjunction short-circuits
expr true || (1 / 0 > 0)
want Bool true

# THE ONE UNKNOWN RULE (spec 2.4): an unknown CONDITION side yields an unknown
# result — never a fault, never silently a value. The decided cases short-circuit
# as they always did.
== unknown left of a disjunction is unknown
expr (1 / 0 > 0) || true
want nil

== unknown left of a conjunction is unknown
expr (1 / 0 > 0) && true
want nil

== a decided disjunction never reaches the unknown side
expr true || (1 / 0 > 0)
want Bool true

== a false conjunction is false whatever follows
expr false && (1 / 0 > 0)
want Bool false

== less
expr 1 < 2
want Bool true

== less or equal
expr 2 <= 2
want Bool true

== greater
expr 3 > 4
want Bool false

== greater or equal
expr 4 >= 5
want Bool false

== equality
expr 1 == 1
want Bool true

== inequality
expr 1 != 2
want Bool true

== text equality
env note: Text = "ready"
expr note == "ready"
want Bool true

== text inequality
env note: Text = "ready"
expr note != "armed"
want Bool true

== ordered comparison through unknown is unknown
expr (1 / 0) > 0
want nil

== equality through unknown is unknown
expr (1 / 0) == 7
want nil

== conditional takes the true arm
expr true ? 1 : 2
want Num 1

== conditional takes the false arm
expr false ? 1 : 2
want Num 2

== conditional chains right-associative
env level: Num = 1.5
expr level > 2 ? 1 : level > 1 ? 2 : 3
want Num 2

== both arms evaluate but the picked one answers
expr true ? 1 : (1 / 0)
want Num 1

== conditional condition must be a condition
expr 1 ? 2 : 3
error ?: wants Bool

== negation wants a condition
expr !5
error ! wants Bool

== conjunction wants conditions
expr 1 && true
error && wants Bool

== comparison refuses mixed shapes
expr 1 == "a"
error comparison mixes Num and Text

== ordered comparison refuses text
expr "a" < "b"
error ordered comparison wants Num
